_comment: THREE SHELVES, in this order. `available` is what a producer is here for and it goes FIRST — finished scripts, unsold, askable today. `produced` is screen and audio that exists in the world, and it is the shelf that carries the directing credits. `published` is the books, on their own shelf because a reader arrives for those and should not have to scan past five audio dramas to find them. Loglines were drafted by Claire at Dario's request on 2026-09-08 from the scripts and books she has read; Dario edits freely. Wild Fires, The Venetian, Party's Over and The Secret Seas of Puglia have none because Claire hasn't read them — that is a gap, not a choice. Set `hidden: true` to pull an entry off the site without deleting it.
_comment_links: `links` is an array of { label, url }. Labels are the ACTION where the action is unambiguous (Listen, Read, Watch) and the PLATFORM where the link is a credit rather than an experience (IMDb). An entry with no links renders no link row — that is correct for finished work that is not yet public.

available.title: The Last Supper
available._hidden_why: Pulled at Dario's request, 2026-09-03. Delete this flag and the two lines above it to put it back — nothing else needs touching.

available.title: Near Dark
available.logline: As the Earth's rotation mysteriously slows and visions throw people into madness, a mismatched crew of survivors chases a mysterious prophet across a dying America - believing he holds the key to unveiling the mystery.
available.note: 'Lost' meets 'The Leftovers' with a dash of 'The Last of Us'. Co-written with With Tomasz Perczynski

available.title: American Cosmic
available.logline: After her client disappears mid-sex, leaving behind a life-changing amount of money, the waitress of a remote California town diner has to dodge the vanished man's wife, the suspicious police deputy, and the eerie lights in the forest that have been taking people from this town for thirty years -- and are coming back for her.
available.note: 'Mulholland Drive' meets 'Close Encounters of the Third Kind'
available._title_why: Retitled 2026-09-08: Dario now calls the script AMERICAN COSMIC (reverted from The Quiet Mile). Vault/CLAIRE folders are still slugged the-quiet-mile.

available.title: Saint Johnny
available.logline: A faith-lost Priest teams up with his eccentric church helper to fight the demonic presence that made the dead priests before him return to life – and accomplish his very first Miracle.
available.note: 'Shaun of the Dead' meets 'Father Ted'. Austin Film Festival Semifinalist

available.title: Wait for Me
available.logline: Two small-time thugs mess up a routine job and inadvertently trigger a deadly clash between their rival Irish mafia families, exposing a forbidden love affair at the heart of the feud. Romeo and Juliet, if nobody in Verona could shoot straight.
available.note: 'Romeo and Juliet' meets 'Reservoir Dogs'. Austin Film Festival Quarter-Finalist

available.title: Maddalena
available.logline: 1983. A letter from a Sicilian priest sends a cellist back to the island she was taken from as a baby, where her mother has spent thirty years in an asylum and her father is the madman the town still crosses the street to avoid. She has half a melody. They have the rest.
available.note: Adapted from the book by Salvatore Colletta Drago

available.title: Karma Police
available.logline: The soul has been proven, patented and put on a subscription. A licensed reincarnation detective takes a case from a boy who believes he was murdered in his last life, and the trail runs from the old cities of Europe to a colony on the Moon.

_comment_truestory: HOLD. Six Dimes / Darkness is my Candle / Running the Amazon are True Story Studios projects. Check with David Aaron Cohen before listing them on a personal site, then move them into `available` or drop this block.

produced.title: Strati
produced.coverAlt: Poster for Strati: a cracked Roman marble bust lit by a single hanging lamp, the title in red beneath it.
produced.note: A project of the Parco archeologico di Ostia Antica, commissioned by the Italian Cultural Authority. Produced by Machineria. Six episodes, full cast, English and Italian.
produced.logline: A body dressed as a Vestal Virgin surfaces in the waters of Trajan's ancient harbour. An Interpol detective in Rome on a favour, a fast-talking taxi driver and an archaeologist dig through two thousand years of the same city to find out who she was, and who looked away.

produced.title: The Secret Seas of Puglia
produced.note: Commissioned by the Puglia Region and the EU CoHeN Programme. Produced by Machineria.
produced.logline: After discovering a mythical mermaid in the Puglian depths, a radio host who moonlights as an artifact thief must battle a dangerous rival to protect the creature—and the soul of the sea itself.

produced.title: Trigger Warning
produced.coverAlt: Poster for Trigger Warning: two cut-paper hands, one shaped into a gun with red-painted nails, above the tagline "The hardest trigger to pull is the one on the inside."
produced.note: Award-winning. Screened internationally, including Rio de Janeiro and Tokyo.
produced.logline: A small-time thug brings a gun home to his girlfriend and explains, over talk of the groceries, that fear and respect are the same thing. She is listening more carefully than he thinks. Six minutes, one room, one trigger.

_comment_cover: COVERS FOLLOW THE LINKS. An entry earns art when there is somewhere public to send someone — that is why The Venetian and Party's Over have none and are correct without it, and why The Secret Seas of Puglia is the one real gap: it has a Listen link and no artwork on this machine. Posters, not square podcast art: the square Apple cards carry a full credit block that turns to mush at 110px, and the posters share the books' portrait ratio so the ledger stays coherent. `cover` is a filename in src/assets/img/, `coverAlt` its alt text. Any entry on any shelf may carry them — the row grows a cover slot when they are set and renders exactly as before when they are not. Extracted from Dario's own EPUBs, not scraped. Give a new cover a 480px-wide JPEG and a slugged filename.
_comment_published: The books. Separate from `produced` on purpose: this is the shelf the reader audience came for, and it is the only one where every `links` entry is a place to actually buy and read the thing.

published.title: Dead Men Naked
published.coverAlt: Cover of Dead Men Naked: a skeleton carrying a scythe, drawn in line on a red ground.
published.logline: When his best friend dies in the flat of a neighbour who turns out to be Death, an unemployed poet ends up on a road trip with the ghost, a girl who stabs him, and Death himself, who drives, eats pancakes, and has lost at chess exactly once.

published.title: Of Life, Death, Aliens and Zombies
published.coverAlt: Cover of Of Life, Death, Aliens and Zombies: a crowd of coral line drawings — a grave, a planet, a figure — on black.
published.note: Individual stories published in The Galway Review, San Francisco Review of Books, and elsewhere.
published.logline: A Pope who admits the Church has been worshipping aliens all along. A writer who survives the zombie apocalypse without ever seeing a zombie. A clinic that rewires your mouth so you can only say nice things. Horror, science fiction and the merely strange, told plainly.
